test: AWS Lambda deployment validation of the real-data prior-authorization model, replaying real CMS formulary feature rows (Lambda Invoke, Function URL payload v2.0)
scope: Test traffic sent by the author, replaying public CMS plan-design rows. Not real users or production workload.

deployment.package: container image (ECR) + AWS Lambda Web Adapter 0.8.4
deployment.built_by: CodeBuild project pbm-claims-build from GitHub commit f21ee17 (no overlay files)

run.note: Split across 3 scripted calls because the tool runner caps each script at 100 AWS calls; the service's own counter shows one continuous execution environment (0 -> 150).
run.phases: 20 normal -> 10 invalid -> 20 shift (real pairs that required PA last year, values unaltered) -> 100 normal recovery

invoke_round_trip_ms.note: Client-side Invoke round trip via the AWS API tool, includes API overhead; server processing p95 was 9.0-9.8 ms (service /monitoring).

cloudwatch.sns_actions: Both alarms executed their SNS action (pbm-claims-scoring-alerts) on entering ALARM.
cloudwatch.note: Alarms use 60 s periods with missing data treated as not breaching; both returned to OK 6 minutes after firing.

other_changes: Paused EventBridge schedule pbm-claims-canary (target pbm-claims-durable-monitor, created 2026-10-24) because it sent synthetic-claims payloads that the real-data model rejects.
